title: Unit 6: Famous Lives: Inversion, Passive & Biographies
objective: Mampu menggunakan struktur inversion dan passive voice untuk menulis dan berbicara tentang kehidupan orang terkenal, serta mampu menganalisis fenomena selebriti dalam masyarakat modern

theory.summary: Unit ini membahas struktur grammar tingkat lanjut untuk membicarakan kehidupan selebriti dan tokoh terkenal. Fokus utama adalah penggunaan modal verbs (may, might, can, could, will, won't) untuk membuat spekulasi dan prediksi, serta should/shouldn't, must/mustn't, can't untuk memberikan saran dan kesimpulan logis. Materi juga mencakup struktur inversion untuk penekanan dalam kalimat formal.
rules: Modal for speculation: 'may/might/could + verb' untuk kemungkinan (You might forget her = mungkin kamu lupa padanya). 'must + verb' untuk kesimpulan kuat (They must be really happy = mereka pasti sangat senang)

Modal for advice: 'should/shouldn't + verb' untuk saran (You should arrive on time = sebaiknya kamu datang tepat waktu). 'mustn't + verb' untuk larangan kuat (You mustn't call anyone = kamu tidak boleh menelepon siapa pun)
Inversion setelah negative adverbs: 'Never have I seen...' (bukan 'I have never seen'). 'Rarely do we...' untuk penekanan formal dalam biografi atau artikel
Expressions with 'take': 'take it personally' (mengambil hati), 'take my word for it' (percayalah padaku), 'take any photos of' (mengambil foto), 'take pride in' (bangga akan)

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Urutan Kata dalam Modal Verbs
commonTrap.explanation: Pemula sering lupa bahwa setelah modal verb (may, might, should, must) harus diikuti bentuk dasar verb tanpa 'to' atau tambahan -s/-ed. Kesalahan lain adalah salah menempatkan 'not' dalam kalimat negatif.
commonTrap.wrong: He might be arrives late. / She should to call him. / They can't to go there.
commonTrap.correct: He might arrive late. / She should call him. / They can't go there.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Dalam penulisan biografi formal, struktur inversion digunakan setelah negative adverbs untuk memberikan penekanan. Manakah kalimat bahasa Inggris berikut yang menerapkan struktur inversion dengan benar?
options: Rarely does she take pride in her achievements despite her fame.
Rarely she does take pride in her achievements despite her fame.
Rarely she takes pride in her achievements despite her fame.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Setelah negative adverb 'Rarely', struktur inversion mengharuskan auxiliary verb (does) ditempatkan sebelum subjek (she), sehingga menjadi 'Rarely does she take...'. Opsi kedua salah karena 'she' ditempatkan sebelum 'does', dan opsi ketiga tidak menggunakan inversion sama sekali.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Kesalahan umum dalam penggunaan modal verbs adalah menambahkan 'to' atau akhiran '-s/-ed' setelah modal. Manakah kalimat berikut yang menggunakan modal verb dengan benar?
options: The paparazzi might to follow the celebrity everywhere she goes.
She must feels a lot of admiration from her fans around the world.
He could become the next big star if he stays in the limelight.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Setelah modal verb (could, might, must, dll.), kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar (bare infinitive) tanpa 'to' dan tanpa akhiran '-s/-ed'. Opsi pertama salah karena menambahkan 'to' setelah 'might', dan opsi kedua salah karena menambahkan '-s' pada 'feel' setelah 'must'. Opsi ketiga benar: 'could become' menggunakan bentuk dasar verb.

readinessQuestions.prompt:
Perhatikan percakapan berikut antara Mum dan Becky tentang ketertarikan Becky pada selebriti tenis:

Mum: "I've never heard you so passionate about tennis, Becky. It's always tennis and always following Osaka on social media."
Becky: "What's the big deal, Mum? [...]"
Mum: "Well, I think you should focus more on playing tennis yourself rather than just following celebrities online."

Manakah respons yang paling tepat dan natural untuk mengisi bagian [...]?
options: She might be one of the greatest athletes of our generation, so I take pride in supporting her.
She might being one of the greatest athletes, so I take pride to support her.
She may to be one of the greatest athletes, so I am taking pride for supporting her.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Opsi pertama benar karena menggunakan modal 'might' diikuti bentuk dasar 'be' (tanpa 'to' atau akhiran) dan ekspresi 'take pride in + gerund' dengan tepat. Opsi kedua salah karena 'might being' tidak gramatikal (seharusnya 'might be') dan 'take pride to' seharusnya 'take pride in'. Opsi ketiga salah karena 'may to be' tidak gramatikal (seharusnya 'may be') dan 'taking pride for' bukan kolokasi yang tepat.

dialogue.context: Percakapan antara Mum dan Becky membahas rencana Becky menonton pertandingan tenis dan mengerjakan tugas sekolah

lines.speaker: Mum
lines.text: I've never heard you so passionate about tennis, Becky. I'm tired of always being indoors. I want to do something outside for a change. What do you think, Becky?
lines.translation: Aku tidak pernah mendengarmu begitu bersemangat tentang tenis, Becky. Aku lelah selalu berada di dalam ruangan. Aku ingin melakukan sesuatu di luar untuk berubah suasana. Menurutmu bagaimana, Becky?

lines.speaker: Becky
lines.text: Sure, Mum. Whatever. Oh no! Seriously? Becky! Just out of curiosity, what are you doing on your phone? No, let me guess. You're reading her Twitter account!
lines.translation: Tentu, Mum. Terserah. Oh tidak! Serius? Becky! Hanya karena penasaran, apa yang kamu lakukan di ponselmu? Tidak, biar aku tebak. Kamu membaca akun Twitter-nya!

lines.speaker: Mum
lines.text: Well, if by 'her' you mean Naomi Osaka – yes, I am. What's the big deal, Mum?
lines.translation: Nah, kalau maksudmu 'dia' adalah Naomi Osaka – ya, benar. Memangnya kenapa, Mum?

lines.speaker: Becky
lines.text: Tennis, tennis, tennis. It's always tennis. And always following Osaka on social media. But seriously, Mum.
lines.translation: Tenis, tenis, tenis. Selalu tentang tenis. Dan selalu mengikuti Osaka di media sosial. Tapi serius, Mum.

lines.speaker: Mum
lines.text: Well you might have told me, Becky. And what about your homework? Aren't you supposed to finish that before seven thirty?
lines.translation: Kamu seharusnya memberitahuku, Becky. Dan bagaimana dengan PR-mu? Bukankah kamu seharusnya menyelesaikannya sebelum jam setengah delapan?

lines.speaker: Becky
lines.text: OK. I'll call off the tennis, do my project work and have it ready by seven. There's no need to be like that. And don't call off your plans. It's just... I think we should set some other interests, that's all.
lines.translation: Oke. Aku akan batalkan rencana tenis, mengerjakan proyekku dan menyelesaikannya sebelum jam tujuh. Tidak perlu seperti itu. Dan jangan batalkan rencanamu. Cuma... Menurutku kita harus punya minat lain juga, itu saja.

speakingLab.context: Latihan percakapan dengan Mr. Khoirul tentang kehidupan selebriti dan pandangan siswa terhadap fenomena ketenaran

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Let's talk about famous people. Which celebrities are you interested in? Maybe someone from sports, music, or social media? Why do you follow them?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I'm quite interested in [name]. I follow them because they're really talented and inspiring. I admire how hard they work to achieve their goals.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's interesting! Now, do you think celebrities have too much attention these days? Some people say we're obsessed with following their lives on social media. What's your opinion?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I think it depends. Some celebrities use their fame positively to raise awareness about important issues. But I agree that sometimes the media focuses too much on their private lives, which isn't always fair.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Good point! One last question: would you like to be famous yourself? What would be the advantages and disadvantages of being in the limelight?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Honestly, I'm not sure. The advantage would be having opportunities to inspire others, but the disadvantage is losing your privacy. I think I'd prefer to be successful without being too famous.

quiz.question: Complete the sentence: You ____ arrive on time if you leave now.
quiz.explanation: Kita menggunakan 'should' untuk memberikan saran atau rekomendasi. Dalam konteks ini, pembicara menyarankan agar pendengar berangkat sekarang supaya tiba tepat waktu.

quiz.question: Which sentence shows the correct use of inversion?
options: Never I have seen such a beautiful performance.
Never have I seen such a beautiful performance.
I never have seen such a beautiful performance.
I have never seen such a beautiful performance.
quiz.answer: Never have I seen such a beautiful performance.
quiz.explanation: Inversion terjadi setelah negative adverbs seperti 'never' di awal kalimat. Urutan yang benar adalah: Never + auxiliary verb (have) + subject (I) + main verb (seen). Ini memberikan penekanan yang lebih formal dan dramatis.

quiz.question: Choose the best modal verb: The paparazzi ____ stop following celebrities because they make money from the photos.
quiz.explanation: 'Won't' (will not) menunjukkan prediksi atau kemauan yang kuat untuk tidak melakukan sesuatu. Dalam konteks ini, paparazzi tidak akan berhenti karena mereka menghasilkan uang dari foto-foto tersebut.

quiz.question: What does 'take it personally' mean?
options: To feel offended or hurt by something
quiz.answer: To feel offended or hurt by something
quiz.explanation: 'Take it personally' adalah idiom yang berarti merasa tersinggung atau sakit hati karena menganggap sesuatu ditujukan kepada diri sendiri. Misalnya: 'Don't take it personally - I always take everything too seriously.'

quiz.question: Complete: They ____ be really happy about the news. (strong conclusion)
quiz.explanation: Kita menggunakan 'must' untuk menyatakan kesimpulan logis yang kuat berdasarkan bukti atau situasi yang kita lihat. 'Must' di sini bukan berarti kewajiban, tetapi kepastian yang tinggi (mereka pasti sangat senang).

quiz.question: Which expression means 'to be the centre of attention'?
quiz.explanation: 'To be in the limelight' berarti menjadi pusat perhatian atau sorotan publik. Istilah ini berasal dari jaman teater kuno yang menggunakan lampu kapur (limelight) untuk menerangi aktor di panggung.
